home.title: MeetCopilot
home.subtitle: CRM core × DynamicSlide × MeetCopilot × simulation training
home.lead: Research the client, prep the deck — then the copilot reminds you what to say while you're in the room.
home.liveNote: During the meeting, share only the "Meeting Slides" tab; run MeetCopilot (capture + suggestions) on account B; the HUD can go on a second device.
home.crmDesc: Company & people intelligence with a research engine
home.presentDesc: Clean playback view — share this tab
home.copilotDesc: Capture audio + live suggestions, one window
home.trainDesc: AI plays the client for live voice practice
home.agendaEmptyHint: Start one now and the copilot listens in, pulls up context, and reminds you what you still have to cover.

crm.title: CRM
crm.headline: {count} clients
crm.createdToast: Client created — you can start researching
crm.emptyHint: Add your first client and let the system fill in the details.
crm.emptyFilteredHint: Try another keyword, or clear the filters.
crm.desc: Company and contact intelligence, confirm/fill provenance, trigger research enrich and crawl status.

studio.title: DynamicSlide Studio
studio.desc: Three-step deck generation wizard, slide editing, pptx export, pre-meeting AI image generation.
studio.launchHint: Static preview just flips slides locally; live meeting playback creates a session so HUD-approved pages append to the deck in real time.
studio.launchError: Couldn't start meeting playback. Please try again.
studio.importProcessingDesc: We're rendering your original presentation into playable pages. This can take a moment — you can leave and come back.
studio.importFailedDesc: We couldn't convert this file. Please go back and try importing again.
studio.importTimeoutDesc: This import is taking longer than expected and may have stalled. Please go back and import the file again.
studio.originalLockNotice: Original presentation slide — kept exactly as imported to preserve the source visuals, so it can't be edited.

present.title: Meeting Slides
present.waiting: Waiting for the presenter to start…
present.emptyDesc: This link doesn't point to a presentation. Go back and pick a deck to start presenting.
present.failedDesc: We couldn't load the slides. Check the link is correct, or try again.
present.connFailedDesc: The live connection to the meeting was lost. Reconnect, or try again later.

presentStart.title: Meeting Slides
presentStart.lead: Pick a deck and start presenting. The playback view is a clean stage (slides only) — that's the tab you share into Meet.
presentStart.playStaticHint: Flip through the slides on this machine only — no meeting session attached.
presentStart.playLiveHint: Attaches to the live meeting session: your page flips sync to the copilot, and approved AI slides append to the end of the deck in real time.
presentStart.noCreds: No meeting session is running yet.
presentStart.shareTip: Tip: once you're presenting, share "this tab" in Meet; press F or the ⛶ button to go fullscreen.
presentStart.emptyHint: Generate or import one in DynamicSlide, then come back to present it.

copilot.title: MeetCopilot
copilot.desc: Start listening, capture the meeting tab audio, and stream it for live analysis.
copilot.captureLead: Captures this Meet tab's audio (everyone, mixed) for the live copilot. This browser tab is never shared.
copilot.capturePlatform: Desktop Chrome / Edge only. Account B's Meet tab and this tab must be in the same browser profile.
copilot.cockpitLead: Capture the meeting audio and read live suggestions — in one window.
copilot.cockpitAccountB: This is your private copilot window (Account B) — shown only on your device and never shared; copilot and HUD are unified on one screen.
copilot.secondDeviceTitle: View the HUD on another device
copilot.secondDeviceDesc: Copy the link below and open it on a phone, tablet, or another tab to watch this meeting's HUD on a second device. (This is the only place in the in-meeting flow that opens another tab — and only when you choose to.)
copilot.secondDeviceEmpty: The HUD link will appear here once you start a session.
copilot.consentInline: I have participants' consent to record and transcribe this meeting to generate live suggestions.
copilot.consentInlineHint: Until this is checked, captured audio is never sent for analysis.
copilot.tabAudioTitle: Before sharing, be sure to tick “Share tab audio”
copilot.tabAudioStep1: Choose “Chrome Tab” and pick the Meet tab (not a whole screen or window).
copilot.tabAudioStep2: Be sure to tick “Share tab audio” at the bottom-left.
copilot.tabAudioStep3: Click “Share” to start capturing the tab's audio.
copilot.zeroTrackRetry: Retry — and remember to tick “Share tab audio”
copilot.objectivePlaceholder: e.g. Get them to agree to a POC next week
copilot.objectiveHint: Auto-drafted once you pick a deck or company; edit freely. With a deck or company set, the HUD shows a talk checklist.
copilot.consentWaiting: Consent given — waiting for the connection/analysis.
copilot.sharingStopped: Sharing stopped (you hit the browser's “Stop sharing”).
copilot.zeroTrackTitle: This share didn't include any audio
copilot.zeroTrackBody: “Share tab audio” wasn't ticked in the picker, or you picked a source without audio (whole screens and windows usually have none).
copilot.setupTitle: Create the session for this meeting
copilot.setupLead: A title is enough to start. Pick a deck or their company and we'll also prepare what to cover and ask.
copilot.needLogin: You're not signed in. Please <login>sign in</login> before creating a session.

hud.desc: Live suggestions, research cards, and transcript; accept/skip and deep research.
hud.noSessionDesc: Create the meeting session on the left and the suggestion stream connects automatically.
hud.connecting: Connecting to the live meeting stream…
hud.connFailedTitle: Couldn't connect to the meeting HUD

suggest.label: You could say this now
suggest.kickerSlide: Want to add a slide for them?
suggest.keysSlide: Keys: A add to deck · S skip

research.title: Look this up

research.exhausted: No lookups left in this meeting

connect.title: Connect to the meeting HUD
connect.lead: This is the presenter's second-device prompt screen. Copy the session link from the desktop copilot and paste it below.
connect.placeholder: Paste the session link, or “meetingId wsToken”
connect.parseError: Couldn't parse that. Paste the full session link, or “meetingId wsToken”.

checklist.title: Talk checklist
checklist.failed: The checklist could not be generated this time (nothing else is affected).

enrichPanel.deepEntryDesc: Full-web news / wiki / public records + the official site + social accounts, with per-field source attribution.
enrichPanel.timeHint: May take 30–60 minutes. You can leave the page and come back for the results later.
enrichPanel.moreDesc: Fill gaps and verify on top of existing data — faster.
enrichPanel.staleBody: Research was interrupted (server restart or timeout). You can start it again.
